items.where: rusticated arcade storey, one round-arched shop opening per bay (0-5.3 m)
items.how: arcadeArch(): glazed round arch, moulded archivolt to the ground, keystone; rustication() courses on the piers

items.where: colossal fluted Ionic half-columns between the bays over storeys 1-3 (6.9-17.4 m); register: kolossale Ionische gecanneleerde halfzuilen
items.how: halfColumn(): pedestal, base, seven-flute half shaft r 0.58 m, echinus/abacus with two volutes

items.where: stone balustrade with candelabra balusters across each bay over the arcade (5.5-6.9 m)
items.how: balustrade(): plinth, rail and turned balusters (3-sided) every 0.46 m

items.where: black wrought-iron balconies in front of the coupled windows of storeys 2 and 3 (9.45 m, 13.45 m)
items.how: ironBalcony(): stone slab, top/mid/bottom rails and nine bars in #26292b; the scrollwork pattern is reduced to bars

items.where: three coupled windows per bay (narrow-wide-narrow) between broad stone stiles, white frames with upper lights, storeys 1-3
items.how: tripleWindow(): glass, transom and bar in white, stone stiles, sill and head band

items.where: architrave, plain frieze and a deep cornice with dentils over storey 3 (17.4-20.6 m); register: tand- en eierlijst
items.how: bands(): stepped architrave/frieze/cornice slabs, dentils() as ledge strips every 0.34 m; the egg-and-dart moulding is not cut

items.where: attic storey (atelierverdieping) with three small coupled windows per bay, pilaster strips over the columns, attic cornice (20.6-22.7 m)
items.how: front(): attic windows, pilaster strips, attic cornice band

items.where: balustrade with pedestals over the attic cornice (22.7-23.75 m); register: de vierde verdieping is voorzien van een balustrade
items.how: balustrade() plus a pedestal over every column

items.where: curved slate mansard behind the balustrade, light zinc rolls over the bay lines (23.45-27.44 m); register: gebogen mansardekap met leien
items.how: sweep() of a five-point curved profile along the fronts, end caps, rib() rolls over the columns; no dormers are visible on nw-full3 / ne-full3

items.where: public toilet kiosk on the pavement in front of the arcade

skip.note: street furniture, not part of the building

items.where: domed tower over the round corner: drum with windows (22-28 m), ring cornice, balustraded gallery, upper drum (28.2-31.6 m), copper dome to 35.4 m, lantern with ball finial to 38.2 m; register: hoge koepeltoren, koepel op hoge tamboer met koper bekleed, lantaarn met bolvormige bekroning
items.how: drum(): open cylinders r 4.75 / 4.05 m, ring cornices, 22 gallery balusters, lathe dome (quarter ellipse 3.95 x 3.85 m), lantern with four openings, lathe cap and sphere; dome ribs not drawn

items.where: HIRSCH & Cie in raised letters round the lower drum, 26.7-27.6 m, centred on the corner, the "ie" small and high
items.how: raisedLettering() per glyph (stroke font, approximate match to the seriffed capitals) set on the drum radius, 0.85 m capitals and 0.45 m "IE"

items.where: carved scroll consoles flanking the drum base over the corner pilasters (23.8-25.6 m)
items.how: a stone block with a horizontal scroll cylinder each side

items.where: square east corner with colossal pilasters on both fronts over a rusticated pier (register: pilasters aan de uiterste hoeken)
items.how: one corner prism, a capital ring and rustication on both faces
